_note: Behaviour and timing assumptions of the follow-up-session simulation (Section 3.3.3; results in Sections 4.2.2-4.2.4). All values are author-specified assumptions unless stated; selection difficulty (alpha) and popup rescue (rho0) are calibrated at run time so that the Best Graphene cohort reproduces 84.0% top-1 and 94.7% post-disambiguation accuracy. Pairs [median, sigma] are lognormal (median in s, sigma on the log scale); pairs [mean, sd] for 'narrative' and 'export_overhead' are normal. Dictionaries keyed 60/70/80 are factory-noise bands in dBA.
_seed_note: Calibration uses seed_base; replicate r uses seed_base + r (cohort allocation) and seed_base + 1000 + r (follow-up session).
